mapper.insert: insert into biz_stock_flow_archive (flow_id, store_id, book_id, location_id, stock_type, biz_type, biz_no, qty_change, qty_before, qty_after, create_by, create_time, remark, archived_at) select f.flow_id, f.store_id, f.book_id, f.location_id, f.stock_type, f.biz_type, f.biz_no, f.qty_change, f.qty_before, f.qty_after, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.remark, #{archivedAt} from biz_stock_flow f where f.create_time < #{cutoff} and not exists (select 1 from biz_stock_flow_archive a where a.flow_id = f.flow_id) order by f.flow_id limit #{limit}

insert into biz_ai_call_log_archive (log_id, store_id, session_id, member_id, scene, model_name, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cache_hit, cost, latency_ms, is_success, error_msg, create_time, archived_at) select l.log_id, l.store_id, l.session_id, l.member_id, l.scene, l.model_name, l.prompt_tokens, l.completion_tokens, l.total_tokens, l.cache_hit, l.cost, l.latency_ms, l.is_success, l.error_msg, l.create_time, #{archivedAt} from biz_ai_call_log l where l.create_time < #{cutoff} and not exists (select 1 from biz_ai_call_log_archive a where a.log_id = l.log_id) order by l.log_id limit #{limit}
